verdict.rationale: Metronome documents API-driven subscription lifecycle management: contracts can be created via API, and subscriptions can be updated through the edit contract endpoint's update_subscription action, with upgrades, downgrades, pricing changes and trials also covered. Pausing and cancelling subscriptions are not documented anywhere in the evidence, so only about half the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented pause endpoint, documented cancel/end-subscription endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, pause, and cancel subscriptions through a documented API — the full lifecycle without touching a dashboard

citations.quote: Use the Metronome API to manage your customer's subscription lifecycle including pricing changes, free trials, upgrades, and downgrades.
Schedule a change of the quantity of a subscription using the update_subscription action on the edit contract endpoint.
PLG onboarding: Automatically provision new self-serve customers with contracts when they sign up.
